title: TriCalRAG: A Three-Strategy, Retrieval-Augmented Benchmark for On-Premise LLM-Based Root Cause Analysis in AIOps
abstract: arXiv:2609.14762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cloud-hosted large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for root cause analysis (RCA) in AIOps pipelines, but they introduce data privacy risk, network latency, and per-query cost that scale poorly with production log volumes. We present TriCalRAG, a benchmark evaluating open-weight LLMs served locally via vLLM on a single high-memory workstation GPU (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, 96GB) against a classical LSTM-based log anomaly detector (DeepLog), across four real, publicly available log datasets (BGL, HDFS, Thunderbird, OpenStack). We evaluate two open-weight models (Qwen2.5-14B, Mistral-Small) under three prompting strategies: zero-shot, few-shot, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a labeled incident history, reporting accuracy, precision/recall, and F1 with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals across 3 random seeds, alongside throughput and VRAM footprint. translated_title: TriCalRAG：一个用于AIOps中基于本地部署LLM根因分析的三策略、检索增强基准测试
translated_abstract: 云托管的大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于AIOps流水线中的根因分析（RCA），但其带来了数据隐私风险、网络延迟，以及随生产日志量增长而扩展性不佳的按查询计费成本。我们提出了TriCalRAG，这是一个基准测试，通过vLLM在单台高内存工作站GPU（NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000，96GB）上本地部署开源权重LLM，与经典的基于LSTM的日志异常检测器（DeepLog）进行对比评估，涵盖四个真实、公开可用的日志数据集（BGL、HDFS、Thunderbird、OpenStack）。我们在三种提示策略下评估两个开源权重模型（Qwen2.5-14B、Mistral-Small）：零样本、少样本，以及基于标注事件历史的检索增强生成（RAG），在3个随机种子下报告准确率、精确率/召回率和F1分数（含bootstrap 95%置信区间），并同时报告吞吐量和显存占用情况。我们的结果表明，RAG不仅将平均F1提升了0.10-0.27……
tldr: 该论文提出TriCalRAG基准，证明在单GPU上本地部署的开源LLM结合检索增强生成（RAG）策略，可在多个真实日志数据集的根因分析任务中显著优于传统DeepLog方法，为AIOps提供了兼顾数据隐私与成本效益的本地化解决方案。
en_tdlr: TriCalRAG is a benchmark showing that locally-deployed open-weight LLMs with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) significantly outperform the classical DeepLog detector for root cause analysis across real log datasets, offering a privacy-preserving and cost-effective on-premise solution for AIOps.
